name: on_death
title: players.on_death
lead: Calls `fn` when a player dies, with the cause (fall, drown, void, lava, ...) and the line broadcast; `player` is nil once they have left.
signature: players.on_death(fn: (player: Player ?, cause: string, message: string, by: Player ?) -> ()) → Connection

params.name: fn
params.type: (player: Player ?, cause: string , message: string , by: Player ?) -> ()

usedIn.quote: players.on_death(function(player, cause, message, by) end) -> connection   -- by: the player who did it, or nil
- At zero health the player dies. `players.on_death` fires with cause
